expected_invariant: Every transaction scenario emits the frozen lock, idempotency and two-check authority token order, and any mismatch identifies its exact group plus expected and observed value-free tokens.
observed_error: Attempt 003 passed all nine authority groups, then failed closed with generic lock_authority_order_mismatch before the eleven-transaction checkpoint. The bounded diagnostic attempt attributed it to TX-S06 authority_revoked: stale-generation or role mismatch correctly stopped after user FOR SHARE and appointment FOR UPDATE, while the harness incorrectly required a grant query that the fail-fast service never reaches.
detection_method: The trace-recovery schema retained only TX-S06, authority_revoked, the expected three-token sequence and observed two-token sequence. Static service inspection confirms role/generation denial precedes the grant query. Both occupied outcomes proved exact relay, container and internal-network cleanup.

correction.action: Admit the exact two-token pre-grant authority-revocation trace alongside the existing three-token missing-grant trace, reject reordered variants, preserve the unchanged service hash, and run the one final occupied attempt allowed by the trace-recovery plan.
correction.prevention_control: Stateful multi-scenario rehearsals must attribute failures to a scenario and retain only allowlisted diagnostic classes sufficient to distinguish harness classification from source-contract defects.
